title: Chiratidzo Chakasvika paChigaro
intro: Munhu akaremerwa akasvika pachigaro chekutonga, inzwi ravo richidedera kwete nekutya asi netariro. Nyaya yacho yaive yemunhu oga, asi mhinduro yayo yaizoramba ichienderera mberi nekufamba kwenguva, ichiparadza tsika inodzvinyirira. Ndiani uyu mweya une kunyunyuta kwakanzwikwa kunze kwenyeredzi?
clues: Ndakauya nemoyo wakaremara, ndichitsvaga kururamisirwa panyaya yaindisunga rurimi.
Chikumbiro changu chakanga chisiri chekutumwa chete; chakakwira kupfuura, kuna Iye anonzwa zvese.
Mashoko akataurwa pamusoro pangu akanga akaita sengetani dzekare.
Ndakakakavadzana ndikafunga, ndichichema uye nepfungwa, kuti ndiremekedzwe.
Zvakaratidzwa zvakauya, zvichinyaradza maitiro ekare uye zvichibvuma kurwadziwa kwangu.
Vanonditi ndini ndakakakavadzana nezvemurume wangu, uye zita rangu rakazofanana nechitsauko chakandisunungura.

arabic: قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَـٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verse: Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing. (58:1)
